# Task: Refactor Roslyn Symbol Lookup to Unified Resolution Strategy

## Background
Roslyn's symbol lookup has separate code paths for different contexts (expression binding, type resolution, member access). This task extracts common patterns into a shared strategy.

## Objective
Create a `UnifiedSymbolResolver` that consolidates the common symbol lookup patterns used across different binding contexts.

## Steps
1. Study symbol resolution in `src/Compilers/CSharp/Portable/Binder/`
2. Identify common patterns in `Binder.LookupSymbolsInSingleBinder`, `Binder_Lookup.cs`, and type resolution
3. Create `src/Compilers/CSharp/Portable/Binder/UnifiedSymbolResolver.cs` with:
   - A strategy interface `ISymbolResolutionStrategy`
   - Concrete strategies for: TypeResolution, MemberAccess, NamespaceResolution
   - A `Resolve()` method that walks scope chains using the strategy
   - Results type that captures both found symbols and diagnostics
4. Create a test file in the test directory

## Key Reference Files
- `src/Compilers/CSharp/Portable/Binder/Binder_Lookup.cs`
- `src/Compilers/CSharp/Portable/Binder/Binder.cs`
- `src/Compilers/CSharp/Portable/Symbols/` — symbol types

## Success Criteria
- UnifiedSymbolResolver.cs exists
- Defines ISymbolResolutionStrategy interface
- Has concrete strategy implementations
- Test file exists

   169→    /// Consolidates common symbol lookup patterns used across different binding contexts by walking
   170→    /// the binder scope chain using a pluggable <see cref="ISymbolResolutionStrategy"/>.
   171→    /// </summary>
   172→    internal sealed class UnifiedSymbolResolver
   173→    {
   174→        private readonly Binder _rootBinder;
   175→
   176→        public UnifiedSymbolResolver(Binder rootBinder)
   177→        {
   178→            _rootBinder = rootBinder;
   179→        }
   180→
   181→        /// <summary>
   182→        /// Resolves symbols by walking the binder scope chain and applying the given strategy at
   183→        /// each scope until a viable result is found.
   184→        /// </summary>
   185→        /// <param name="name">The symbol name to resolve.</param>
   186→        /// <param name="arity">The arity (number of type parameters).</param>
   187→        /// <param name="strategy">The resolution strategy to apply at each scope.</param>
   188→        /// <param name="options">Additional lookup options.</param>
   189→        /// <returns>A <see cref="SymbolResolutionResult"/> containing found symbols and diagnostics.</returns>
   190→        public SymbolResolutionResult Resolve(
   191→            string name,
   192→            int arity,
   193→            ISymbolResolutionStrategy strategy,
   194→            LookupOptions options = LookupOptions.Default)
   195→        {
   196→            var useSiteInfo = CompoundUseSiteInfo<AssemblySymbol>.Discarded;
   197→
   198→            // First pass without diagnostics for performance.
   199→            var result = LookupResult.GetInstance();
   200→            WalkScopeChain(name, arity, strategy, options, result, diagnose: false, ref useSiteInfo);
   201→
   202→            if (!result.IsMultiViable && !result.IsClear)
   203→            {
   204→                // Retry with diagnostics to produce detailed failure information.
   205→                result.Clear();
   206→                WalkScopeChain(name, arity, strategy, options, result, diagnose: true, ref useSiteInfo);
   207→            }
   208→
   209→            ImmutableArray<Symbol> symbols = result.IsMultiViable
   210→                ? result.Symbols.ToImmutableArray()
   211→                : ImmutableArray<Symbol>.Empty;
   212→
   213→            ImmutableArray<Diagnostic> diagnostics = result.Error != null
   214→                ? ImmutableArray.Create<Diagnostic>(new CSDiagnostic(result.Error, Location.None))
   215→                : ImmutableArray<Diagnostic>.Empty;
   216→
   217→            result.Free();
   218→
   219→            return new SymbolResolutionResult(symbols, diagnostics);
   220→        }
   221→
   222→        private void WalkScopeChain(
   223→            string name,
   224→            int arity,
   225→            ISymbolResolutionStrategy strategy,
   226→            LookupOptions options,
   227→            LookupResult result,
   228→            bool diagnose,
   229→            ref CompoundUseSiteInfo<AssemblySymbol> useSiteInfo)
   230→        {
   231→            bool foundFirst = false;
   232→            for (var scope = _rootBinder; scope != null && !result.IsMultiViable; scope = scope.Next)
   233→            {
   234→                if (foundFirst)
   235→                {
   236→                    var tmp = LookupResult.GetInstance();
   237→                    strategy.LookupInSingleScope(scope, name, arity, options, tmp, _rootBinder, diagnose, ref useSiteInfo);
   238→                    result.MergeEqual(tmp);
   239→                    tmp.Free();
   240→                }
   241→                else
   242→                {
   243→                    strategy.LookupInSingleScope(scope, name, arity, options, result, _rootBinder, diagnose, ref useSiteInfo);
   244→                    if (!result.IsClear)
   245→                    {
   246→                        foundFirst = true;
   247→                    }
   248→                }
   249→            }
   250→        }
   251→    }
   252→}
